issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies numberOfLecturers as an int, but the solution uses a byte field and a constructor parameter of type byte for numberOfLecturers, and the setter accepts a byte. This is an attribute/type mismatch versus the specification and may confuse students about which type to implement for numberOfLecturers and what parameter type the setter/constructor should use.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of numberOfLecturers consistent with the UML/specification. Change the field and constructor/setter parameter types in the solution (and template guidance if present) to int, i.e., private int numberOfLecturers; public Lecture(..., int numberOfLecturers, ...); public void setNumberOfLecturers(int numberOfLecturers). Alternatively, if byte is intended, update the problem statement/UML to state byte for numberOfLecturers so students are not confused.
